title: SPRInG: Continual LLM Personalization via Selective Parametric Adaptation and Retrieval-Interpolated Generation
abstract: arXiv:2601.09974v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Personalizing Large Language Models typically relies on static retrieval or one-time adaptation, assuming user preferences remain invariant over time. However, real-world interactions are dynamic, where user interests continuously evolve, posing a challenge for models to adapt to preference drift without catastrophic forgetting. Standard continual learning approaches often struggle in this context, as they indiscriminately update on noisy interaction streams, failing to distinguish genuine preference shifts from transient contexts. To address this, we introduce SPRInG, a novel semi-parametric framework designed for effective continual personalization. During training, SPRInG employs drift-driven selective adaptation, which utilizes a likelihood-based scoring function to identify high-novelty interactions, selectively updating the user-specific adapter on drift signals while preserving hard-to-learn residuals in a replay buffer. Durin

translated_title: SPRInG：通过选择性参数化自适应与检索插值生成实现大语言模型的持续个性化
translated_abstract: 个性化大语言模型通常依赖于静态检索或一次性适配，并假设用户偏好随时间保持不变。然而，现实世界的交互是动态的，用户兴趣会持续演变，这给模型在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下适应偏好漂移带来了挑战。标准的持续学习方法在这种场景下往往表现不佳，因为它们不加区分地在嘈杂的交互流上进行更新，无法区分真实的偏好转变与瞬时的情境变化。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SPRInG，一个旨在实现有效持续个性化的新型半参数化框架。在训练阶段，SPRInG采用漂移驱动的选择性适配机制，利用基于似然的评分函数识别高新颖性交互，在漂移信号出现时选择性地更新用户专属适配器，同时将难以学习的残差保存在回放缓冲区中。
tldr: SPRInG提出了一种半参数化持续个性化框架，通过基于似然的评分函数识别真实的偏好漂移并选择性更新用户专属适配器，同时将难学残差存入回放缓冲区，从而在用户兴趣持续演变的情况下实现大语言模型的个性化而避免灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: SPRInG is a semi-parametric framework that enables continual LLM personalization under evolving user preferences by using a likelihood-based scoring function to selectively update user-specific adapters on genuine preference drift, while preserving hard-to-learn residuals in a replay buffer to avoid catastrophic forgetting.
